content.title: Taking a mock test?
content.subtitle: A mock is not just for a score. It's for catching your mistakes.

steps.title: Real test conditions
steps.detail: Set a timer, keep your phone away, do the full test in one go. No breaks in between.

steps.title: Note your mistakes
steps.detail: Next to each wrong answer, write why it went wrong: time, vocab or understanding.

steps.title: Find the pattern
steps.detail: Making the same kind of mistake again and again? That's the real work.
steps.tip: The IELTS kit's Failure Patterns tab is made for this.

steps.title: Focus on weak sections
steps.detail: Don't study everything again. Spend time where you're losing marks.

steps.title: Take another mock
steps.detail: After a few days of practice, take the next mock. You'll see the difference.
steps.tip: The IELTS kit has a free full mock, with sign-up.

caption:
Took a mock, saw the score, moved on? Don't. Here's the right way to use a mock 👇

1. Real test conditions
2. Note your mistakes
3. Find the pattern
4. Focus on weak sections
5. Take another mock

Save this 📌 and send it to a friend who needs it.
